==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
Two men and one woman have been trapped inside of a pocket dimension inside of a school locker. The sky in the pocket dimension is purple. The space is full of floating brown islands.

The two men are traversing this pocket dimension on a mission to save the woman. Outside of the pocket dimension is the resurrected mummy of a witch. She is wrapped in bandages and she has long messy silver hair.

The witch casts a spell to try and take over the mind of one of the men, offering them freedom in return for control of the man's body. But the man, despite being badly wounded, refuses the witch's offer and dispels her vile magic. He refuses to give up on his search or leave the other man behind, even if that means he may never escape.
